name: B10-0347/2026 (ESN) – The abduction, forced conversion and child marriage of Maria Shahbaz and the protection of girls in Pakistan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the abduction, forced conversion and child marriage of Maria Shahbaz and the protection of girls in Pakistan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Pakistan to return abducted girls to their families and to prosecute men who use religious conversion to cover abduction. It asks Pakistan to enforce child protection and anti-child-marriage laws, raise the minimum marriage age, and make courts check a girl's real age and free consent. It also urges European Union countries to crack down on sexual exploitation networks and deport foreign child offenders. The text is a statement of opinion and requests; it does not change any law itself.

- Nothing changes in law; the Parliament only states positions and makes requests.
- It targets Pakistan's government and courts, and European Union member states.
- Next, the resolution is sent to Pakistan and European Union institutions; follow-up depends on them.
